name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not ensure the box is picked up again after each fall; it allows `holding_box` to be true before the fall. Use `Precedence(box_fell, holding_box)` so each required pickup follows a fall. Keep the hard exit goal and `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` for carrying the box at the exit.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not ensure the box is picked up again after each fall. Because `holding_box` is a lasting condition, it is owed again on every step it holds; the initial carrying state can satisfy it without any pickup after the fall. The task requires picking it up again, so use `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` to require carrying on the very next step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` only requires carrying the box on the same step as or after reaching the exit; it does not require carrying it when reaching the exit. The task says to carry the box to the exit. Replace it with a requirement that `holding_box` holds at `at_exit` (for example, `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` does not express that).

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not require picking the box up again after each fall. It allows holding_box to be true before or on the fall step, so a fall can go unanswered. The task requires a pickup after the fall; use ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box).

CHANGES REQUIRED: Precedence(box_fell, holding_box) forbids carrying the box before it falls, but the task says to carry the box to the exit, and the agent starts holding it. Replace this with Response(box_fell, holding_box) to require picking it up again after each fall. Also, Response(at_exit, holding_box) does not ensure the box is held on the exit step; it allows holding it later. Use a clause that requires holding_box at the exit, such as Response(holding_box, at_exit) would not express that requirement either. The existing Existence(at_exit) plus a correctly grounded exit-and-carry requirement is needed.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not require pickup on the next step; it allows any later step. The task says to pick up the box again whenever it falls, and the environment says it can be picked up on the very next move. Replace this with hard `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)`. Keep the other clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not require pickup after each fall if the box falls again while it is being carried: the new obligation can be met by the same carrying period. The task says to pick the box up again whenever it falls. Use ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) so pickup must happen on the very next step after each fall.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not require a pickup after each fall; it only requires holding_box at or after the fall, so the box may already be in hand before a fall. The task says to pick it up again whenever it falls. Use a rule that requires a later pickup after each fall.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box when reaching it, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking the box up after each fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Carry the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again.
